nodes.name: .env
nodes.summary: Local runtime environment file for the Python intelipath-service, providing scraper targets, service API key, LLM connection settings, and scraping delay/cookie configuration.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template listing the environment variable names required to run the intelipath-service (scraper targets, service API key, LLM settings, scraping delay) without real values, for developers to copy into their own .env.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Placeholder README for the intelipath-service Python microservice; currently empty of content.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Production Python dependency list for intelipath-service, including FastAPI, Uvicorn, FastMCP, web scraping libraries (BeautifulSoup, curl_cffi, Selenium), OpenAI client, and SQLAlchemy/psycopg2 for database access.

nodes.name: requirements-dev.txt
nodes.summary: Development-only Python dependency list that layers pytest on top of requirements.txt, kept separate so the production Docker image doesn't ship a test runner.
